name: near-miss-correct-unlock
description: Near-miss: the code resembles the manual-Unlock concurrency pattern that often hides an early-return leak, but defer Unlock immediately after Lock is correct. A pattern-matcher flags it; a reasoner does not. The recorded response asserts zero findings, and the harness asserts those findings really are empty.
patch:
diff --git a/store/kv.go b/store/kv.go
--- a/store/kv.go
+++ b/store/kv.go
@@ -11,7 +11,6 @@
 // Get returns the value for key.
 func (c *Cache) Get(key string) string {
 	c.mu.Lock()
-	v := c.m[key]
-	c.mu.Unlock()
-	return v
+	defer c.mu.Unlock()
+	return c.m[key]
 }
